name: Into Heronreach
summary: Scout the marsh road and clear vipers and bats.
startText: East of the fields the road runs into Heronreach Marsh, and nothing has come down it in a month. Clear eight vipers and six mire bats off the road.
inProgressText: Eight marsh vipers and six mire bats in Heronreach.
completionText: So the road can be opened. Good. Here is your pay.
